hero.title: Replay and spectate AOE2 matches with one click.
hero.lede: Follow players, launch recent replays, and when there is an important match, spectate in-game or pick from a list of all caster streams covering it.
hero.imageAlt: AOE2 game viewer live spectating screen
features.title: Built around the moments spectators repeat every day.
features.replay.title: Load recent replays instantly
features.replay.body: Replay any player's recent games, including your own, with one click from a clear match history list. No searching, downloading, unzipping, copying, or guessing which recorded-game file to open.
features.replay.alt: Recent matches replay list with one-click play buttons
features.live.title: Spectate live games and find casters
features.live.body: See when a followed player is in game, launch the live spectate link, or open live caster streams already covering the match.
features.live.alt: Live match status and caster streams
sponsors.title: Thank you to the players supporting AOE2 game viewer.
sponsors.note: Sponsors are listed only when they opt in from the app.
final.title: Install AOE2 game viewer and open your next match from one screen.
